Name: east coast line
Notes: runs along the east coast with express service across peninsula line; to be extended into city loop

Name: sunset bay loop
Notes: loops around the sunset bay with express service across peninsula line

Name: across bay line
Notes: designed to cut across sunset bay and pointer bay and improve connectivity within eastern borough 5 and pointer island

Name: island line
Notes: previously borough line for the islands; extended and took over part of originally planned across bay line

Name: pointer bay line
Notes: connects the neighbourhoods surrounding pointer bay; also known as line 5B

Name: peninsula line
Notes: full overlap with both sunset bay loop and east coast line
